scraped.scraped_description: NumFOCUS promotes open practices in research, data, and scientific computing. We run educational programs and fiscal sponsorship of open source projects.

name: NumFOCUS
tagline: A Nonprofit Supporting Open Code for Better Science
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Dependency on volunteer contributions to sponsored projects
published_performance_metrics: Annual impact reports available on numfocus.org
curation_criteria: Projects must be open source, scientifically focused, and demonstrate community adoption
contributor_governance: Community-driven with elected board of directors and project advisory committees
disparity_tracking: Diversity and inclusion initiatives tracked through annual reports; focus on underrepresented groups in STEM
community_ownership: High - member projects retain autonomy while receiving organizational support
ai_involvement: Supported projects include machine learning and AI tools; NumFOCUS itself does not directly develop AI systems
political_relevance_summary: NumFOCUS sustains open-source scientific computing infrastructure that underpins data analysis used in policy research, civic data projects, and government decision-making, though its primary mission is science rather than politics.

movement_building_utility.notes: NumFOCUS provides foundational data infrastructure, standards, or platforms that other civic technology efforts build upon.

generalizability_notes: High generalizability. NumFOCUS is open source and already deployed across multiple countries/jurisdictions, making replication straightforward for other contexts.
